title: Class III vapor retarders.
officialText:
Class III vapor retarders shall be permitted where any one of the conditions in Table 1405.3.1 is met.

CLASS III VAPOR RETARDERS

is deemed to meet the insulating sheathing requirement where the spray foam R-value meets or exceeds the specified insulating sheathing R-value.

a. Spray foam with a minimum density of 2 lbs/ft3 applied to the interior cavity side of OSB, plywood, fiberboard, insulating sheathing or gypsum
